queue_item: S1 in docs/RESEARCH_QUEUE.md; source-blocked since Step 202 and unblocked in Step 252
question: Does year-over-year change in 10-K language predict returns on this universe?
hypothesis_from_literature: Cohen, Malloy and Nguyen, 'Lazy Prices'. Filings that change more from one year to the next predict LOWER subsequent returns, so the tradeable signal is similarity: high similarity long, low similarity short. The sign is declared here so a result of the opposite sign cannot later be reinterpreted as confirmation.
why_this_matters_here: Every signal in this registry is a transform of prices or of reported numbers. Step 245 measured 1.57 effective independent strategies and Step 246 showed more assets of the same kind do not help. Filing prose is a different information channel, which is the only reason this is worth the acquisition cost.

data.text: data/sec_filing_text_v1/parsed (9,746 documents, iXBRL header and hidden blocks removed)
data.causality: the comparison is available at the filing date of the newer 10-K; forward returns start from the first weekly close strictly after that date

notes_on_sections: item_1a extraction is approximate: heading regexes over normalised text pick the longest properly terminated span, and the first attempt was wrong in a way that produced 39,025-word risk sections. item_7 and full are declared; item_1a is measured and reported but is not one of the twelve trials.

controls_that_must_pass.causality: no filing may enter a decision before its filing date; a prefix-invariance check must show that adding later filings does not change earlier signal values
controls_that_must_pass.placebo: the same pipeline on shuffled similarity scores, to confirm the estimator returns zero
controls_that_must_pass.length_confound: similarity correlates mechanically with document length. IC must be measured after controlling for the change in word count, because a signal that is really 'the filing got longer' is not a language signal
controls_that_must_pass.cost: 0, 10, 50 and 100 bps. Annual rebalancing means turnover is low, so this is expected to pass and is reported for completeness rather than as a hurdle
controls_that_must_pass.correlation: against existing strategy paths. The entire case for this branch is orthogonality, so a correlated result is worthless even if profitable

interpretation_fixed_in_advance.if_no_configuration_clears_bonferroni: record as a negative result and close S1. The text channel was tested properly and did not pay on this universe.
interpretation_fixed_in_advance.if_the_sign_is_opposite_to_the_literatur: record it as a failed replication, not as a discovery. A reversed sign on a documented effect is more likely a construction error or a sample artifact than a new finding.
interpretation_fixed_in_advance.if_it_clears_and_survives_the_length_con: a genuine candidate and the first non-price signal family in this project; it still enters at the bottom of the gate list with no forward evidence
interpretation_fixed_in_advance.if_it_clears_only_before_the_length_cont: reject; the signal is document length wearing a costume
